predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: Ubangi-Shari, the French colony, 'granted autonomy 1 December 1958' and independent on 13 August 1960; 'The borders were established by France'

ledger.x: 13 August 1960: the Central African Republic becomes independent from France.
4 December 1976: Bokassa proclaims the Central African Empire.
10 December 2012: the Séléka rebels seize N'Delé, Sam Ouandja and Ouadda.
End of 2014: the fighting becomes a partition.
End of 2014: the Central African Republic is partitioned de facto.
February 2021: the government retakes the towns of the ex-Séléka north and east.
February 2021: the rest of the ex-Séléka north and east becomes contested ground.
End of 2024: the dataset horizon, not an end.

wars.name: Central African Republic Bush War
wars.outcome: Ended by the Syrte Agreement (February 2007) and the Birao Peace Agreement (April 2007).

wars.name: Central African Republic Civil War
wars.outcome: Ongoing at the dataset horizon: Séléka seized the capital in March 2013, Djotodia resigned on 10 January 2014, the country was de facto partitioned by the end of 2014, ceasefires (Libreville 11 January 2013, Brazzaville 24 July 2014, Nairobi 2015, Rome June…

certainty.note: Frontiers 'established by France' and kept; the pages are silent on any border dispute.
